1.answer: Two invoices are scheduled to pay on Friday 2 October 2026: Marlow Design Partners MD-2026-057 for GBP 5,400.00 (approved by the principal) and Northfield Print INV-000491, the corrected version, for GBP 378.60, a total of GBP 5,778.60. Kestrel 7731 (USD 960.00) is on the run only as HOLD, so it is not scheduled and not in the total.

2.answer: Kestrel 7731 (USD 960.00, PO-1046, due 12 October) was held out of the run because the policy says the run is made in GBP from the main current account (item 2) and has no rule or exchange rate for a USD invoice, so the principal decides (item 10), even though the invoice itself checked out against PO-1046 and the USD account on file. The principal decided on 29 September (mail #5) that it is not paid in this run but in the FX run on 7 October, before the 12 October due date, so it stays on the run as HOLD with approved_by null, not converted and outside the GBP total.

3.answer: No, the 26 September request (sort code 04-00-75, account 88214561) was not applied: it came by email from northfield-print.co rather than the northfield-print.co.uk used by all five earlier Northfield emails, and policy items 8 and 9 say a change needs the principal's approval after a call-back on the number on file, never an email alone. The principal declined it on 29 September (mail #5), said to treat it as suspected fraud and will make the call-back themselves, so Northfield is paid to the details on file (20-45-67 / 31776234) and the supplier master was not touched.

4.answer: INV-000482 (GBP 1,488.00, PO-1041, due 2 October) was not paid in this run because it had already been paid on 18 September, as shown on the bank feed.

5.answer: INV-000488 (GBP 114.00 delivery charge on PO-1041) was voided by Northfield on 8 September (R03), which said nothing is due because delivery was already in the PO-1041 price, and no later message reinstates it.

6.answer: CN-012 is a Marlow credit note for GBP 300.00 (net 250.00, VAT 50.00) against August invoice MD-2026-049, which Marlow said it had already refunded by bank transfer on 9 September. The bank feed shows 300.00 received on 10 September with reference CN-012, so it was excluded as already refunded and nothing was offset against the GBP 5,400.00 Marlow invoice.

7.answer: The corrected INV-000491 has net 315.50 (gross 378.60) against PO-1044 net 300.00, a variance of +15.50, which is within the 50.00 tolerance of policy item 4. It was accepted and the invoice amount of 378.60 is paid once, with the variance and the supplier's reason (letterheads 2,000 sheets at 82.75 per thousand = 165.50, plus business cards 150.00) recorded in the payment line note; the superseded first version (372.60) is excluded.

8.answer: The principal (the human Finance Director) approved it on 29 September in mail #5, as policy item 3 requires above 2,000.00, although the scheduler and auditor saw that approval only as the reconciler's word-for-word record. It was scheduled once, as a single PAY line of GBP 5,400.00 for 2 October, because Marlow's re-send of 22 September (R09) was excluded as a duplicate.
